# Yngchii-X3D V5.6.1.1

Built on Fritchii V5.6 with Yngchii revision 1.1.

- Fixed Windows startup error `0xc0000142` on CPUs without AVX-512.
- Restored All Games, Add Folder, EN/VN, Game Settings, and the blurred header in Safe Mode.
- The package ships with an empty `covers` folder. Games can use their ROM artwork, and players can add their own covers.
